data.title: Provisional benefit decision (Vorläufige Bewilligung von Leistungen zur Sicherung des Lebensunterhalts)
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispielsee provisionally grants Veronika Beispielhuber Bürgergeld/ALG II benefits of €1,087.60 per month for the period 1 May 2027 to 31 October 2027, because her income from a mini-job (geringfügige Beschäftigung) is not yet confirmed.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter is paying you benefits provisionally because your mini-job income isn't fully verified yet. You must send in your payslips (Lohnabrechnungen) for February, March and April 2027 by 14 May 2027 — if you miss this, the Jobcenter may decide you weren't entitled to benefits for those months. If you disagree with the decision itself, you can also file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show you the deadline for that. No other action is needed right now besides gathering and sending the payslips.

items.title: Submit payslips for February to April 2027 (Lohnabrechnungen)
items.action: Send the Jobcenter your payslips (Lohnabrechnungen) for February, March and April 2027.
items.consequence: Without these documents, the Jobcenter can determine that you had no entitlement to benefits for the affected months.
items.quote: Reichen Sie uns bitte bis 14.05.2027 Ihre Lohnabrechnungen für Februar bis April 2027 ein.

items.title: Decide whether to object to this decision (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether you want to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision, if you disagree with it, and submit it to Jobcenter Beispielsee.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed within the deadline shown, the decision becomes final.
